# truenas_nvmet_host (Data Source)

Looks up a TrueNAS NVMe-oF host (initiator) by hostnqn. Never exposes DH-CHAP secrets: this datasource has no "dhchap_key" or "dhchap_ctrl_key" attribute.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hostnqn` (String) NVMe Qualified Name (NQN) of the host (initiator) to look up.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Free-form description of the host.
- `dhchap_dhgroup` (String) DH-CHAP Diffie-Hellman group used for bidirectional authentication.
- `dhchap_hash` (String) DH-CHAP hash algorithm (SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512).
- `id` (Number) Numeric NVMe-oF host ID assigned by TrueNAS.
